mentions.name: Behaviour Change App
mentions.description: This app teaches users how to actually change their behaviour instead of simply tracking habits, using micro skills such as value alignment and self-compassion that apply across all aspects of life and help users change bad habits.
mentions.problem: The author has used habit tracking apps and found them absolutely useless because they don't teach users how to actually change their behaviour.
mentions.source_excerpt: Thinking about vibe coding a Behaviour Change App as opposed to a simple habit tracking app. I have personally used the habit tracking apps, and they are absolutely useless. My app will help the users learn how to actually change their behaviour, teaching them micro skills like value alignment, self-compassion, etc.
